position: Ready for a small backend spike, not public launch
headline: The backend prototype is ready for founder review.
copy: The local source packet path, fixture CLI, and private demo ledger are complete enough to choose the first real backend spike.

postures.title: Source packet contract
postures.copy: Trace, citation, family, confidence, reviewer state, rights posture, and boundary are defined.

postures.title: No-source behavior
postures.copy: Unsupported modern claims return explicit no-source packets.

postures.title: Fixture runner
postures.copy: Oppenheimer, steady action, Gayatri hold, and no-source cases are testable locally.

postures.title: Private demo ledger
postures.copy: Event names and storage boundaries are defined, but not production-approved.

postures.title: Public launch
postures.copy: Live service, privacy controls, security, rights, reviewer operations, and support remain open.

flow.title: Run stub
flow.copy: Use the local source API module for deterministic lookup.

flow.title: Run fixtures
flow.copy: Verify source-found, hold, review, and no-source behavior.

flow.title: Review ledger
flow.copy: Check that private demo learning avoids sensitive storage.

flow.title: Choose spike
flow.copy: Decide whether the first backend is a Node API, serverless function, or separate service repo.

decisions.label: Private backend spike
decisions.reason: A tiny endpoint can mirror the local Source API stub after founder review.

decisions.label: Real retrieval corpus
decisions.reason: Needs rights, source edition, reviewer workflow, and storage model.

decisions.label: Demo telemetry
decisions.reason: Needs consent, export/delete, retention, and privacy approval before pilot use.

decisions.label: Public launch
decisions.reason: The product is not launch-ready until service, rights, review, privacy, security, and support are real.

decisions.label: Payment or accounts
decisions.reason: No billing or identity until production trust controls exist.

locks.title: Live AI lock
locks.copy: No generated answer pipeline is enabled by this batch.

locks.title: Storage lock
locks.copy: No production user or reviewer data is stored.

locks.title: Rights lock
locks.copy: No licensed text display is assumed.

locks.title: Privacy lock
locks.copy: Telemetry remains a contract, not an active collection system.

locks.title: Launch lock
locks.copy: Private demo readiness is not public launch readiness.

packet:
Backend Readiness Control Room v4.7.0
Ready: local Source API stub, retrieval fixture CLI, private demo ledger contract, backend readiness gate.
Blocked: live AI answer generation, licensed corpus display, production accounts, durable storage, payments, public launch.
Founder next decision: choose a tiny backend spike or continue fixture hardening.
